description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mampe. Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521202 (23/0837)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property details. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
